mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-14830, 11148) and has to end up at (12049, 7228). On the way it must stop at A (Holsworthy (Military) Airport) at (-18278, -10628), B (Rosehill Heliport Airport) at (-11616, 7773), C (Auburn Medical (Wyatt Park) Helicopter Landing Site) at (-10075, 4633), D (Wanda Beach Helipad) at (1246, -15622); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Sydney Kingsford Smith International Airport (YSSY, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Sydney Bankstown Airport (YSBK, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 107076 meters. The battery only allows 112386 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Westmead CareFlight Base Heliport; DEST is Watsons Bay Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
